C0190.title: Ordinary Video Gains 3 Million Views Overnight: Shaanxi Police Expose Fake Traffic Scam
C0190.summary: Shaanxi police cracked a major online water-army fraud case involving media companies that sold fake video views by promoting the idea that high traffic could quickly be monetized. One company claimed that 19,800 yuan could buy 10 million exposures, while the actual traffic-farming cost was only 30 yuan and the labor for video editing and copywriting totaled 150 yuan. Police arrested 195 suspects, seized 197 computers and 290 mobile phones, and had criminally detained 128 people on suspicion of fraud at the time of the report.
